item.title: Quebec's spring time change is this weekend — Here's what you need to know
item.description: Daylight saving time is almost here, and this year it's arriving with a side of warm weather.On Sunday, March 8, 2026, clocks in Quebec spring forward one hour to 3 a.m. That means one hour of your precious sleep will vanish. If you're still out when it happens, your Saturday night just got shorter, too, since bars lose an hour of service. item.title: Canadian passport fees are going up this month — Here's how much more you'll pay
item.description: If you've been putting off renewing your passport, now might be the time to get moving.According to a federal government announcement, Canada is changing how it calculates citizens' passport fees, and the new prices kick in on March 31, 2026. Instead of using a preset formula, fees will now be adjusted annually based on inflation, specifically tied to Canada's All-items Consumer Price Index.
